title: Managing IAM Roles and Permissions
objectives: Understand the importance of IAM roles in securing cloud resources.
Learn how to list IAM roles using AWS CLI.

mission_brief.situation: As a cloud operator, you need to manage IAM roles and permissions to ensure secure access to your cloud resources.
mission_brief.mission: List all IAM roles in your account using AWS CLI.
mission_brief.execution: Use the correct command to list IAM roles.

content.walkthrough: List IAM roles using AWS CLI
checkpoints: Verify the output contains all IAM roles in your account.
Understand the importance of role policies in securing cloud resources.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to use the correct command

safety: Do not modify or delete any IAM roles during this exercise.

bug_injection.bug: Incorrect IAM role permissions causing access denied error.
bug_injection.symptom: Users cannot access cloud resources due to permission issues.
bug_injection.fix: Review and update IAM role policies to ensure correct permissions.

pass_conditions: All IAM roles are listed correctly.

interrogation_questions: What is the purpose of IAM roles in securing cloud resources?
How do you list all IAM roles in your account using AWS CLI?

prohibited: Modify or delete IAM roles without permission

resume_bullets: Managed IAM roles and permissions for secure cloud access.
Updated role policies to ensure correct permissions.
